A storm can also represent transformation and change, making the name an emblem of personal growth and evolution.

In the Bible, we read about God’s covenant with Noah, bringing an end to the Great Flood with a storm. This name can remind us that God is in control even during the most tumultuous moments in our lives, and that He ultimately leads us to a place of peace and restoration.
